title: Unsafe unarchiving via NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject (swift) — review required
description: The swift call NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject rebuilds objects from archive bytes. Hostile archives instantiate unexpected classes. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms trust or requires unarchivedObjectOfClass with requiresSecureCoding.
remediation: Require secure coding (unarchivedObjectOfClass with requiresSecureCoding) and allowlist classes.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject call matches.
